sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: What do two little hands do in the poem?
Choose the naming word (Noun) in this sentence: The cat is sleeping.
What did Anandi see outside her window?
Choose the correct article: I have ___ umbrella.
Which of these is a healthy food?
Complete the sentence with the correct position word: The ball is ___ the table.
In which season do we wear warm sweaters?
Choose the correct pronoun: ___ is playing with a ball. (referring to a boy)
Who took the caps from the cap seller?
Choose the correct plural: One book, many ___.
How do you greet your teacher when you enter the classroom in the morning? (10-15 words)
questions.answer: I smile and say, 'Good morning, teacher!' when I enter the classroom.

questions.question_text: Name two animals you can easily see on a farm. (5-10 words)
questions.answer: We can see cows and hens on a farm.

questions.question_text: Name any two colours that Anandi painted her flowers with. (5-10 words)
questions.answer: Anandi painted the flowers with red and yellow colours.

questions.question_text: Rewrite this sentence with a capital letter and a full stop: my name is ravi (5-10 words)
Why should we eat healthy food instead of junk food? (10-15 words)
questions.answer: We should eat healthy food to grow strong, get energy, and not fall sick.

sections.section_name: Section C - Grammar & Matching (Fill in the Blanks)

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks with the correct Action Words (Verbs): 1. The fish ___ in the water. 2. The frog ___ on the grass. (swims / hops)
Fill in the blanks with the correct Describing Words (Adjectives): 1. An elephant is a ___ animal. 2. The sun is ___. (yellow / big)
Imagine you have a magic cap like the cap seller, but yours can do magic. What colour is it and what magic does it do? (20-30 words)
questions.answer: I have a magic cap that is bright blue. When I put it on my head, I can fly high up in the sky like a bird.

questions.question_text: Think of a rainy day. Describe what you see people holding and what the sky looks like in two sentences. (20-30 words)
questions.answer: The sky is filled with dark grey clouds. People are holding red and green umbrellas to stay dry from the heavy rain.
